# ChannelScale

ChannelScale offers managed short-form content for client-owned accounts and separately scoped creator-led clipping campaigns. The managed account offer describes 60 unique clips per month, with selection, editing, approvals, publishing and performance review.

- Offer: https://channelscale.yt/offer
- Work and sources: https://channelscale.yt/work
- Inquiries: https://channelscale.yt/apply
- Clipper community: https://channelscale.yt/clippers

Pricing is custom after source review. Creator campaigns have a separately agreed brief, budget and management scope. Results are examples, not guarantees. Filming and full episodes require a separate scope. The free Whop community shares opportunities as they become available; membership does not guarantee work or earnings.
